is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii) in Benin.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotype counts for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) and Ace-1 G280S (ace-1R) in Table 3.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for kdr-west and ace-1R for each species and locality.

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae were collected from five communes in southern Benin (Adjohoun, Allada, Bohicon, Cotonou, and Porto-Novo) and reared to adults.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies five communes: Adjohoun, Allada, Bohicon, Cotonou, and Porto-Novo.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was carried out from August 2017 to July 2018.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection of mosquitoes from 2017-2018.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the intensity of pyrethroid resistance and the role of PBO synergism in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations from five communes in southern Benin. It also characterized the frequency of kdr-west and ace-1R resistance markers and measured detoxification enzyme activity.
